notes.title: TOA 1.1
notes.notes: We have updated The Odarian Accounts, fixing most bugs that were found throughout the game, and made some major changes that will allow for a smoother experience for the player.

notes.title: Update Notes - March 19th 2023
notes.notes:
We have made some minor updates to actual game fixing some grammatical errors found throughout and have made some tweaks to a mini game that wasn't performing as intended. 

The MAC OS and LINUX/STEAMDECK versions of the game have been repaired and updated to make sure they are working on those platforms. 

We hope that the changes will make your experience a lot better. Stay tuned, there is more to come.

notes.title: Mac and Linux Issues
notes.notes:
We have decided to remove Mac OS and Linux support whilst we look into the issues that seem to be effecting players trying to access the game on those platforms. While we try to bring a fix to the problems as soon as possible the ability to purchase those versions of the game will be restricted. We are sorry for the inconvenience this may cause but please bare with us.

FosterGamesUK
